texte.Le taux OWASP est plafonné par les trois: The OWASP rate is capped by the three risks outside Annex A. This cap is not a flaw in the calculation: it is what the list itself says about its own scope.
texte.Le taux affiché est celui de vos système: The rate displayed is that of your RECORDED systems. If some are missing, you compare yourself favourably with a sector that has counted everything.
texte.Le taux le plus bas est nommé : c’est ce: The lowest rate is named: that is the one that will show in an inspection, not the average.
texte.Le taux rendu ici est un taux de PRÉPARA: The rate given here is a READINESS rate. Neither the bill nor the framework is in force: what binds you today remains the Directive.
texte.Le taux se compose de trois parts — cali: The rate is made of three parts — calibration, measures, evidence — and the first governs the other two.
texte.Le terme d’hébergement vaut # Wh PAR REQ: The hosting term is worth # Wh PER REQUEST. A system billed per token declares tokens: the number of calls is unknown, and deducing it from an average response length would put into your deliverable a figure that nobody declared. These systems are NAMED rather than filled in. To count them fully, declare the billing unit “requests” where that is the case.
texte.Le terme d’hébergement vaut # Wh par REQ: The hosting term is worth # Wh per REQUEST.
texte.Le texte de la norme est la propriété du: The text of the standard is the property of CEN: this module cites its paragraph numbers and titles, and nothing else. The framework's questions are written by the firm. Implementing it assumes you hold the draft, which is obtained from a national member of CEN — AFNOR in France.
texte.Le titre II porte vingt-six articles et: Title II carries twenty-six articles and Title III fourteen;
texte.Le total perçu au titre des jalons ne pe: The total received for the milestones cannot exceed the contractual envelope above. In the event of partial progress, only the milestones achieved are due: the execution risk is borne by the Provider.
texte.Le trait ambre sur la barre: The amber line on the bar
texte.Le traitement et la divulgation des vuln: Vulnerability handling and disclosure are required on both sides: the work is done once.
texte.Le troisième palier — # M€ ou # % — vise: The third tier — €# million or # % — targets incorrect information given to the authorities. Answering a request quickly and badly costs more than answering it slowly and correctly.
texte.Le vert dit que chaque étape a été ouver: Green says that each step has been opened — not that the work of each one
texte.Le vert ne vaut pas présomption de confo: Green does not amount to a presumption of conformity: this draft is not yet cited in the Official Journal. The day it is, the same work will carry a presumption.
texte.Le volume que vous venez de déclarer pou: The volume you have just declared for cost also serves the footprint — divided by a rate on one side, multiplied by watt-hours on the other. No second inventory to keep.
texte.Le « OU » des seuils financiers est le p: The “OR” in the financial thresholds is the trap: €# million turnover with a €# million balance sheet is still a MEDIUM-sized enterprise. Reading it as an “AND” over-qualifies.
texte.Lecture bancaire du référentiel et fiche: Banking reading of the framework and declared / calculated site records.

texte.Les KPIs en haut et le tableau détaillé: The KPIs at the top and the detailed table use the same actual data — no inconsistency between the two.
texte.Les QUATRE usages de l'annexe III, point: The FOUR uses in Annex III, point #
texte.Les RONDS sont des systèmes d’IA, posés: The CIRCLES are AI systems, placed at the location of the organisation that deploys them — its head office, not necessarily where the system runs. A hollow circle marks a national scheme or a non-EU provider. The SQUARES are data centres, coloured by status from the most certain to the most fragile: operating, under construction, authorised, announced — and ABANDONED projects are kept deliberately, because a refusal says as much as an announcement about a territory’s constraints.
texte.Les accès ouverts aux personnes visées,: Access opened to the people concerned, enough AI literacy not to take the machine at its word, and a pilot case on a scope where errors can be caught.
texte.Les amendes de l'article # sont applicab: The fines of Article # have been applicable since # August # (Art. #(b)).
texte.Les analyses d’impact requises identifié: The required impact assessments identified, and the high risks brought to light.
texte.Les articles # et # demandent une évalua: Clauses # and # require an AI system impact assessment. Start from the one you already have.
texte.Les articles # et # — les rapports sur l: Articles # and # — the reports on the review of the framework — have NO counterpart. No control in the standard produces them.
texte.Les articles « mutualisables » se greffe: The “shareable” articles graft onto a management system
texte.Les autorités nationales (ANFR en France: National authorities (ANFR in France, with ANSSI support) check the conformity of products placed on the market.
texte.Les autres sont des outils posés sur un: The others are tools placed on an unchanged process — the gain quantified in the business case will not reach them.

texte.Les cinq entrées de l’analyse (#): The five inputs to the analysis (#)
texte.Les cinq scénarios sont des repères du c: The five scenarios are the firm’s benchmarks: mid-range choices, not a standard. Your organisation’s adoption plan replaces them. Beware of the electricity mix lever: it changes NOTHING in the electricity consumed or the primary energy, it only shifts the emissions. Confusing it with an efficiency gain is the most common mistake.

texte.Les cumuls d’exposition qu’une lecture s: The accumulations of exposure that a site-by-site reading does not reveal.
texte.Les deux autres angles morts : la respon: The other two blind spots: the personal liability of managers (Art. #) and registration with the authority (Art. #(#)).
texte.Les deux ou trois sites qui font le résu: The two or three sites that make the result — an estate is steered by the tails of its distribution, not by its average.
texte.Les deux règlements ont des paliers DIST: The two Regulations have SEPARATE tiers, on separate facts: the same incident can fall under both, and the fines do not offset each other.
texte.Les deux tables de correspondance de la: The two correspondence tables of the
texte.Les deux taux se lisent ensemble : le se: The two rates are read together: the second is capped by the first, and the gap between them says what remains to be built BENEATH before tailoring anything.
texte.Les deux textes comptent des choses diff: The two texts count different things — NIS # your entity, the CRA your products. The measure is shared, not the qualification.

texte.Les délais de l’article # sont courts :: The deadlines in Article # are short: the escalation workflow must exist BEFORE the first incident, not be improvised on the day.
texte.Les exigences de l’annexe I et les artic: The requirements of Annex I and Articles # and # fall under the heaviest tier: €# million or # % of worldwide turnover.
texte.Les goulots d’étranglement identifiés av: The bottlenecks identified before they block a go-live.
texte.Les générations ajoutent volontiers une: Generated output readily adds a neighbouring feature, an option, a cache. What was not requested was not specified, so not reviewed, so not tested — and yet it ends up in production.
texte.Les huit domaines à haut risque — biomét: The eight high-risk areas — biometrics, critical infrastructure, education, employment, essential services, law enforcement, migration, justice — do not reach extraction as such. Two doors remain: Annex I through the Machinery Regulation for embedded AI, and Annex III, point # as soon as an operator’s performance is assessed.
texte.Les indicateurs marqués DÉCLARÉ sont des: The indicators marked DECLARED are assertions, and this document presents them as nothing else.
texte.Les indices sont comparés MOT POUR MOT à: The clues are compared WORD FOR WORD with the declaration. A rewording, even an accurate one, cannot be verified: the proposal then moves to “to be completed”, with the list of what is missing.
texte.Les journaux sont ce qui rendra votre us: The logs are what will make your use demonstrable — and monitoring is what will let you suspend in time rather than explain afterwards.
texte.Les lacunes sont séparées selon l’étape: The gaps are separated according to the life-cycle stage declared in the register. A system IN DESIGN has no volume because it consumes nothing: that is not a gap. A system IN PRODUCTION has none because nobody has recorded it: that is one. Without this split, an estate of twenty systems of which twelve are in design shows eight “missing” rows as a reproach, and you set off chasing twelve teams that have nothing to declare.
texte.Les lignes du registre voyagent en donné: The register rows travel as data in the request;
texte.Les mentions d'information sont accessib: Information notices are accessible at the time of collection
texte.Les mesures produites servent de preuve: The measurements produced serve as evidence before the administration. A model that corrects them must say that it corrects them.
texte.Les modules, accrochés aux scores réels: The modules, tied to the actual scores
texte.Les montants sont un ordre de grandeur C: The amounts are a CATALOGUE order of magnitude, calculated on published and dated rates. An enterprise contract, a volume discount, a context cache or deferred processing give a different real cost, sometimes by an order of magnitude. Nothing here replaces reading your invoice, and nothing is measured: Sentinel does not run in your applications. The optimisation levers are DECLARED, never verified — a ticked box says a cache exists, not that it is switched on.
texte.Les objectifs s’appliquent à TOUS les sy: The objectives apply to ALL systems.
texte.Les obligations DORA sont adaptées à la: DORA obligations are adapted to the size, nature, complexity and risk profile of each financial entity.
texte.Les obligations ci-dessous sont celles d: The obligations below are those of this role, and of this role alone. The same system can be high-risk for all operators without each of them owing the same things.
texte.Les obligations de transparence de l’art: The transparency obligations of Article # apply from # August #, but machine marking is prepared upstream: it affects the content production chain, not just how content is displayed.
texte.Les obligations des articles # à # relèv: The obligations in Articles # to # fall under the intermediate tier: €# million or # % of worldwide turnover.
texte.Les obligations du fournisseur ne s’arrê: The provider’s obligations do not stop at placing on the market: they run for the whole lifetime of the system.
texte.Les onze mesures neuves sont nommées : r: The eleven new controls are named: threat intelligence, cloud services, ICT readiness, physical security monitoring, configuration management, information deletion, data masking, data leakage prevention, monitoring activities, web filtering, secure coding.
texte.Les organes de direction doivent approuv: Management bodies must approve the cybersecurity risk-management measures, oversee their implementation, and can be held personally liable in the event of a breach.
texte.Les paramètres par défaut sont les plus: Default settings are the most protective
texte.Les pastilles rouges et orange signalent: The red and orange dots flag the points to deal with first.
texte.Les personnes concernées peuvent-elles c: Can data subjects understand, challenge and obtain human review of an automated decision?
texte.Les personnes ont le droit de ne pas fai: People have the right not to be subject to a decision based solely on automated processing that produces legal effects.

texte.Les praticiens doivent comprendre et pou: Practitioners must understand and be able to challenge AI recommendations. Enhanced human oversight (Art. #) on every medical decision.
texte.Les privilèges d'une organisation ne dis: An organisation’s privileges do not exempt its suppliers established in the Union from their own obligations. Compliance is handled in the contract.
texte.Les projets ABANDONNÉS sont conservés ex: ABANDONED projects are deliberately kept in the framework: a refusal says as much as an announcement about a territory’s constraints.

texte.Les questions sont rédigées par le cabin: The questions are written by the firm from the paragraphs of the standard, of which only the numbers and the titles are cited. Answering « yes » here is not evidence: it is a declaration, and the technical documentation is what makes it demonstrable.
texte.Les raccourcis « tout retenir » et « tou: The “include all” and “exclude all” shortcuts save thirty-eight clicks, not thirty-eight decisions: the statement remains inadmissible as long as the reasons are missing.

texte.Les scores de risque sont des estimation: Risk scores are CONSEILPREV estimates intended as decision support and do not constitute legal advice. Sources: official texts (Federal Register, EUR-Lex, European Commission, CAC) and law firm analyses.
texte.Les scores sont auto-declares. Cette eva: Scores are self-declared. This assessment does not constitute legal advice. For a certified audit, contact christophe.cerf@outlook.com
texte.Les sept caractéristiques de confiance n: The seven trustworthiness characteristics do not add up: they are traded off. Making a system more explainable can make it less secure.
texte.Les six chemins ci-dessus s’arrêtent au: The six paths above stop at the edge of this page — but a siting decision does not stop there. The Sentinel sidebar carries, under “Data centres”, FIVE roles that start here and continue elsewhere: siting, energy-water-climate, finance and insurance, non-financial reporting, and compliance of hosted AI. Each one opens this page on the path that concerns it, then moves on to the Digital footprint, legal advice, the risk matrix, the AI register or the Executive view. The framework positions and compares; those modules quantify your scope and document your evidence — the boundary between the two is deliberate, and the path takes you across it at the right moment.
